how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-wailing-caverns-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1489:details:0: The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen. I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land. It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.
rows.quest:1489:details:1: The Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint. But before you go there, speak with ⟦E1⟧, the elder druid. I sent word to him of the happenings in the ⟦E2⟧. He is wise, and can offer you counsel.
rows.quest:1489:details:2: You will find him in ⟦E3⟧, on the Elder Rise.
rows.quest:1489:completion:0: I bid you greetings, ⟦1⟧. You are welcome here, and I suggest you gather all your strength. For the task we now set before you ... is a dire one.
rows.quest:1490:details:0: I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns. I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way. They are now servants of the taint seeping through the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1490:details:1: I am old and my strength fails. I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids. But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce. She remained in the dreaming when I fled.
rows.quest:1490:details:2: Speak with Nara. She is in the tent, over yonder.
rows.quest:1490:completion:0: Yes, it is true. I know of the druids in the Wailing Caverns. I have seen their twisted, scaled faces. I know their crimes, and I know their plans.
rows.quest:1486:obj:0: Nalpak in the Wailing Caverns wants 20 ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1486:details:0: As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the ⟦E2⟧ into the Wailing Caverns.
rows.quest:1486:details:1: These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in ⟦E6⟧. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.
rows.quest:1486:details:2: If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.
rows.quest:1486:progress:0: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, ⟦3⟧?
rows.quest:1486:completion:0: Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:959:obj:0: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz in Ratchet wants you to retrieve the bottle of ⟦E7⟧ from Mad Magglish who is hiding in the Wailing Caverns.
rows.quest:959:details:1: Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.
rows.quest:959:details:2: Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.
rows.quest:959:details:3: Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
rows.quest:959:progress:0: The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.⟦5⟧⟦6⟧If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
rows.quest:959:completion:0: Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.
rows.quest:959:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦7⟧. Nicely done, I say!
rows.quest:962:details:0: The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great ⟦E10⟧ of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, ⟦8⟧. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:962:details:1: Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named ⟦E9⟧. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.
rows.quest:962:details:2: Unfortunately ⟦E9⟧ can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:962:progress:0: I am eager to see if you can gather enough ⟦E9⟧ from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
rows.quest:962:completion:0: Ah, splendid specimens. You have done well, ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:1491:obj:0: Bring 6 portions of ⟦E12⟧ to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1491:details:0: Ok, so the raptor horns didn't work so well. But that's all right -- no one got rich on their first try! And besides, I think I found something that'll work even better in my smart drinks!
rows.quest:1491:details:1: There is a substance called ⟦E12⟧, and I think it is the cause of the strange plants and animals in the ⟦E2⟧. Get me some and I'll try it in my drink!
rows.quest:1491:details:2: I heard the essence gathers in ectoplasmic creatures in the Wailing Caverns to the west. Hunt those creatures and gather the essence.
rows.quest:1491:completion:0: Great, you got it! I can't wait to try it out. This is going to make me a fortune, I just know it!
rows.quest:1491:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦10⟧. Take this, and after I'm rich I'll send you more, I promise!
rows.quest:1487:obj:0: Ebru in the Wailing Caverns wants you to kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.
rows.quest:1487:details:1: Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.
rows.quest:1487:details:2: Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.
rows.quest:1487:details:3: While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.
rows.quest:1487:details:4: Brave the caverns, ⟦11⟧, and eradicate the deviate spawn.
rows.quest:1487:progress:0: ⟦12⟧, we, the Disciples of Naralex, need your help. Our numbers are dwindling with our master trapped in his twisted nightmare. We have not the forces necessary to deal with the corrupt creatures which now haunt these caverns.⟦13⟧⟦14⟧I beg of you, enter the caves and wage war on the deviate creatures!
rows.quest:1487:completion:0: As a Disciple of Naralex, I commend your bravery, ⟦15⟧.
rows.quest:1487:completion:1: Your aid in ridding the caverns is the first step in our long plight to see the ⟦E2⟧ restored.
rows.quest:1487:completion:2: Thank you and may you prosper.
rows.quest:914:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E13⟧ of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to ⟦E4⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:914:details:0: The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration. They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to ⟦E14⟧ the ⟦E2⟧, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.
rows.quest:914:details:1: The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem. Even now their faces haunt me! Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the ⟦E2⟧ may again know peace.
rows.quest:914:details:2: Go, ⟦16⟧. You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
rows.quest:914:progress:0: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, ⟦17⟧. Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
rows.quest:914:completion:0: You have done it, ⟦18⟧. You killed the leaders of the Druids of the Fang. My dreams are now free of their wicked faces, and you have helped save the ⟦E2⟧ from a cursed future.
rows.quest:914:completion:1: I thank you, ⟦19⟧. I thank you for myself, for the druids of ⟦E3⟧, and for the land.
rows.quest:6981:obj:0: ⟦E15⟧ to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.
rows.quest:6981:obj:1: Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.
rows.quest:6981:details:0: The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.
rows.quest:6981:details:1: Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.
rows.quest:6981:progress:0: Hello, ⟦20⟧. What can I do for you?
rows.quest:6981:completion:0: Oh... I have never seen anything like this...
